name: MAF bZIP transcription factor B

function.text: MAFB encodes transcription factor MafB. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to multicentric carpo-tarsal osteolysis with or without nephropathy (autosomal dominant); Duane retraction syndrome 3 with or without deafness (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Plasma cell myeloma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
